3.1.value: CADENCE: DAILY - stockholders may request repurchase of all or part of their shares any day at that day's NAV per share (plan first announced 2011; contrast monthly/quarterly windows at BREIT/SREIT). CAP: 5% of the combined NAV of all classes per calendar quarter (~20% of total NAV per printed 12-month arithmetic).
